productionPaths.contract: advanceLocal increments gen; current/non-stopped loader callback admits through photoPause, presents, then schedules local EXIF caption. The central clear hides the previous caption while this metadata is pending.
advanceRemote increments gen; current/non-stopped remote callback presents, then schedules SMB caption or retains existing non-SMB clear. No source or credential IO is added.
Native feed and history converge on presentNative; history navigation cancels the old request (advances gen), and feed captures a fresh gen before admission.
publishCaption posts to the actual PausableFrameCallbacks queue and evaluates g == gen at dispatch. New clear adds no gen mutation or callback cancellation.
Prepared bitmap callbacks are delivered through the shared controller main queue. SlideshowPhotoPause remains the admission boundary for held automatic scenes.
setCaption(null,null) uses default null memory, hides the complete caption panel, and is a no-op if the panel is absent or work is stopped.
The active Music host constructs photosOnly=true; new clear skips its lazy caption renderer. This is a handoff claim only.
